scaling.description: Scales a numeric modifier field (`field`, default `value`): it applies once per `per` of `of` (rounding `round`, default down), optionally capped at `max_value`. E.g. '+2 to the Attacks characteristic for every 5 enemy models within 6"' -> modifier.value 2 with scaling { per: 5, of: 'enemy-models-in-range', within_inches: 6 }.

field.description: The modifier field the scaling multiplies (default value): count for re-roll/return-models, modifier for a test's penalty.

keyword.description: Only models with this keyword are counted.

rule-state-core-rule-slug.$comment: Closed vocabulary of core-rule slugs a `rule-state` effect may toggle (rule_kind: core-rule). These are 10e CORE RULES/mechanics (not core abilities — those are entities, reached via rule_kind: ability). Finite, slow-moving; AJV-enforced, stripped from codegen. The slug — not direction/target — disambiguates active vs passive of the same rule: `fire-overwatch` (the bearer firing Overwatch) vs `overwatch-against-bearer` (the bearer being targeted by Overwatch). For rule_kind `ability`/`faction-rule` the slug is a free string resolved by integrity.ts against the matching entity; `keyword` is a free string (open keyword set).

dice-requirement.$comment: A single dice-allocation requirement: a pair/triple/single/run of dice at or above min_value.

dice-requirement-spec.$comment: Either a single dice-requirement, or an `any_of` set of them — the option activates if ANY is met. The any_of form models blessings that trigger on a double of X OR a triple of Y (World Eaters Blessings of Khorne: the top three blessings).

single-effect.description: One effect: a type, the unit-ref it applies to (`target`), and that effect's closed `modifier`.

oneOf.title: stat-modifier effect
oneOf.description: [characteristic] Change a characteristic of the target's models or their weapons. incoming: the change applies to attacks made against the target.

oneOf.title: ignore-modifiers effect
oneOf.description: [characteristic] Ignore modifiers to characteristics or rolls (all of them, or only worsening ones).

oneOf.title: roll-modifier effect
oneOf.description: [roll] Add to or subtract from a roll. cap bounds a stacking modifier; value_from takes the value from an earlier step's roll.

oneOf.title: re-roll effect
oneOf.description: [roll] Re-roll a roll: only 1s, every failure, or any result; count caps how many. mandatory: the rule re-rolls (it does not only permit one).

oneOf.title: roll-result effect
oneOf.description: [roll] Fix a roll's result (pass, fail or a value; unmodified: it counts as that unmodified result), make it succeed only on an unmodified N+, fail on an unmodified N or less, or make it critical on N+ or on any success.

fails_on.description: An unmodified result of N or less always fails; higher results use the normal success rule.

succeeds_on.description: The roll succeeds on an unmodified N+ and fails otherwise.

oneOf.title: end-attack-sequence effect
oneOf.description: [roll] The attack sequence ends for that attack.

oneOf.title: ability-grant effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Give the target a named ability: a core ability or an ability record. value is its rating (Scouts 6", Firing Deck 2).

oneOf.title: keyword-grant effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Give the target unit keywords, optionally replacing others.

oneOf.title: weapon-ability-grant effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Give the target's weapons weapon abilities. if_present: increment raises an ability the weapon already has by the granted rating.

oneOf.title: weapon-grant effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Equip the target with a weapon.

oneOf.title: ability-modifier effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Change one named ability: its uses, range, targets, recipients, selections, how many can apply at once, duration, start round, threshold or options.
Every ability of the target whose effect reaches units matching this filter.
The ability the trigger's used event names.
Every ability of the target with this keyword (PSYCHIC).

cap_per.description: The changed allowance still applies at most count times per period (two uses, but only one per battle round).

not_same.description: The extra use cannot be made in the same phase (turn) as the use that triggered it.

consumes_shared_use.description: This unit's use does not count toward the shared (once per phase per army) limit for other units.

oneOf.title: ability-activate effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Make a named ability resolve now, or make one of its options active (exclusive: only that option). select: which option is picked now (by a fresh roll, or by the player), in addition to those already active. ignore_consumed: the option may be picked even if a once-per-battle selection already used it. override: the activation resolves with this amount instead of its own.

oneOf.title: permission effect
oneOf.description: [permission] Allow or forbid an activity. after: in a turn in which the unit made that move; despite: something that would normally block it; as_if: as if in that phase or using that shooting type; next: the unit must be the next one selected; reach: an extended distance.

counts_as_move.description: Doing so counts as having made this move this turn (a disembark counting as a Normal move).

consumes_shared_use.description: This use of the Stratagem does not count toward its once-per-phase limit for other units.

oneOf.title: targeting effect
oneOf.description: [permission] Who may, may not or must target whom, under which limit.

to.description: redirect: attacks (or Stratagems) that target `target` must target this unit instead.

if_eligible.description: redirect: only if `to` is an eligible target.

except.description: cannot-target with Stratagems: Core Stratagems can still target it.

oneOf.title: counts-as effect
oneOf.description: [permission] The target counts as being within a range of something, or inside a region.

oneOf.title: rule-state effect
oneOf.description: [permission] Switch a named rule on or off for the target.

oneOf.title: mortal-wounds effect
oneOf.description: [protection] The target suffers mortal wounds: a count, or a count per success on a roll per model.

oneOf.title: damage-reduction effect
oneOf.description: [protection] Reduce the Damage of attacks allocated to the target.

oneOf.title: feel-no-pain effect
oneOf.description: [protection] The target has a Feel No Pain save.

oneOf.title: invulnerable-save effect
oneOf.description: [protection] The target has an invulnerable save of at least this.

oneOf.title: heal effect
oneOf.description: [models] Models in the target regain lost wounds.

oneOf.title: return-models effect
oneOf.description: [models] Return destroyed models to the target unit. bodyguard_only: only Bodyguard models; exclude_model_keyword: models with these keywords do not return; detach: the returned model is set up as its own unit (leaving the attached unit) with Starting Strength starting_strength.

oneOf.title: destroy-models effect
oneOf.description: [models] Destroy models in the target.

oneOf.title: act-on-death effect
oneOf.description: [models] A destroyed model can fight or shoot before it is removed.

oneOf.title: split-unit effect
oneOf.description: [models] Split the target unit: into units of these sizes, one unit per model, or one unit per listed model keyword.

bind_as.description: Names each resulting unit, in model_counts order, for later {selection_var} references.

oneOf.title: add-unit effect
oneOf.description: [models] Add a unit to your army: a copy of a destroyed unit, or a named datasheet, with model_count models and Starting Strength starting_strength; join: the new models join that unit instead of forming a new one.

allow_engagement_with.description: The new unit can be set up within Engagement Range of this unit only.

oneOf.title: destruction-rule effect
oneOf.description: [models] The target unit counts as destroyed only once another model or unit is also destroyed.

oneOf.title: move effect
oneOf.description: [move] The target makes a move now. A surge move carries its core limit (21.02).
Retired free tokens; the record repair moves each onto the typed item.
models: models (of `owner`, with every `all_of` keyword, excluding models with any `excluding` keyword); terrain: terrain features (of `height`).

counts_as_move.description: The move counts as this kind of move for rules that check what the unit did this turn.

ends_when.description: Where the moving unit must be when the move ends, as a condition on it: "your unit must end that move either wholly within your deployment zone or within range of an objective marker". For a single distance to a place, use ends_within.

oneOf.title: move-modifier effect
oneOf.description: [move] Change how the target's moves work.
Retired free tokens; the record repair moves each onto the typed item.
models: models (of `owner`, with every `all_of` keyword, excluding models with any `excluding` keyword); terrain: terrain features (of `height`).

oneOf.title: set-up effect
oneOf.description: [placement] Set the target up: onto the battlefield or into Strategic Reserves, with the placement limits the rule prints. allow: false forbids that set-up instead. mandatory: it must be set up this way. arrives: it arrives in your next Movement phase (allow_first_round: even in the first battle round).

counts_as_move.description: Being set up this way counts as having made this move this turn.

oneOf.title: marker effect
oneOf.description: [placement] Place or relocate a marker.

oneOf.title: transport-capacity effect
oneOf.description: [placement] How models count against a Transport's capacity: grouped models, fixed spaces per model, an equivalent model, or the Transport's own capacity with per-model spaces.

oneOf.title: test effect
oneOf.description: [test] Force the target to take a test (count or per: several rolls).

oneOf.title: state-change effect
oneOf.description: [test] Set or clear a state on the target.

oneOf.title: cp-gain effect
oneOf.description: [resource] Gain (or lose) CP.

oneOf.title: cost-modifier effect
oneOf.description: [resource] Change what a Stratagem, manoeuvre or ability costs.

oneOf.title: resource-gain effect
oneOf.description: [resource] Add to a resource pool.

oneOf.title: resource-spend effect
oneOf.description: [resource] Spend from a resource pool. face: spend dice showing this value; requirement: spend dice forming this pair, triple or run.

oneOf.title: resource-die effect
oneOf.description: [resource] Add a die to a pool, or substitute a pooled die for a roll.

oneOf.title: objective-sticky effect
oneOf.description: [designation] An objective the target controls stays under your control until the opponent's control is greater at the end of a phase.

oneOf.title: designate effect
oneOf.description: [designation] Tag a unit, objective or terrain area (or clear the tag).

by.description: The unit that applies it, when it matters whose designation it is (their Spotted unit).

oneOf.description: Retired spellings of turn, phase and battle; the record repair moves them onto the shared expiry.

oneOf.title: army-rule effect
oneOf.description: [army] A rule that applies when mustering the army.

per.description: composition: max applies once per unit matching this filter (one per INQUISITOR).

attach_as.description: attachment: a Leader that can join a unit matching this filter can join this unit.

oneOf.title: test-exemption effect
oneOf.description: [test] The target does not need to take this test again within the window (no further Battle-shock tests this phase).

oneOf.title: datasheet-swap effect
oneOf.description: [identity] The target unit uses another datasheet from now on (its profile, keywords and abilities), keeping its wounds and position.

oneOf.title: characteristic-resolution effect
oneOf.description: [characteristic] How a characteristic that differs between the target's models is resolved: the value most models have (ties: the higher or lower), or the highest or lowest. applies_to: only for that purpose.

oneOf.title: borrow-weapons effect
oneOf.description: [ability] The target (a Transport) uses one ranged weapon from each of up to max_models models embarked within it (Firing Deck); those models cannot shoot.

oneOf.title: select-weapon effect
oneOf.description: [ability] Pick one of the target's weapons (count of them) and bind it; weapon-qualified effects refer to it as weapon_ref {weapon_var}.

min_choices.description: Minimum number of distinct options selected at this activation; defaults to one.

max_choices.description: Maximum number of distinct options selected at this activation; defaults to one.

rules-bundle-effect.description: A reusable named ability's complete effect bundle. Other abilities grant it through an ability-grant effect whose modifier.ability names the containing ability.

ability-part.description: One part of a compound ability: an effect with its own moment (trigger), usage limit, cost or choice, shown as one bullet of the ability it belongs to. The ability's own trigger is its firing moment; a part's trigger is the moment of that part alone, in the same trigger shape. `name` is only for a part the rules name (a psychic power, a named rule in a bundle).

name.description: The part's own name, only when the rules give it one.

optional.description: Whether the controlling player may decline this part.

cost.description: A prerequisite cost: the part's effect applies only after this complete cost is paid. An optional part may be declined without paying it.

duration.description: Expiration of this sub-effect, independently of sibling rules in an enclosing bundle.

trigger.description: The moment this part fires on, in the ability trigger's shape. When the part sits inside an activated effect, it applies only for the enclosing effect's duration.

usage.description: How often this part may be used, when the limit is the part's and not the whole ability's.

threshold.description: Fixed threshold or model characteristic to compare against

rider.description: Marks this gate as the RIDER half of a roll-with-rider composition: a `sequence` whose first step is this gate and whose second step is the unconditional primary. The gate's effect fires on the roll and the primary resolves regardless, so the sequence renders with a mandatory "Regardless of the result" clause. Structurally identical to a real gate (a `dice-gated` with `on_success` and no `on_fail`), which is why the distinction is declared rather than inferred.

test.description: Perform the named actual 2D6 test using the subject's current Leadership and normal applicable modifiers and reroll permissions. A Battle-shock failure inflicts Battle-shock as well as resolving on_fail; a Leadership test does not.

from.description: Gate the dice of a roll an enclosing `roll` step bound instead of rolling new dice.

requirement.description: With `from`: succeeds when the bound roll's unused dice form this pair, triple or run; those dice are then used up.

kind.description: Which roll this is (a Psychic test), so modifiers and re-rolls to that roll apply.

dice-table-effect.$comment: Resolve one dice roll against an exhaustive outcome table. Each face belongs to exactly one outcome; overlap and coverage are enforced by referential integrity because JSON Schema cannot compare sibling arrays.

dice.description: One closed die whose faces are covered exactly once by outcomes.

count.description: Roll this many dice and resolve each one on the table.

distinct.description: Each outcome applies at most once; a repeated result is re-rolled.

select-units-effect.$comment: Targeting wrapper: choose up to `selector.max_count` units, or a bounded exact/inclusive count when `selector.min_count` is present, matching `selector.keywords` of the named `owner`; apply the nested `effect` to each selected unit. Optional range, visibility, and engagement gates are bearer-relative candidate predicates evaluated before the nested effect.

target_kind.description: Whether the selector binds whole units or individual models.

range_inches.description: Distance from bearer to each selected unit.

visibility_required.description: When true, each selected candidate must be visible to the bearer.

engagement_relation.description: Candidate engagement relation to the bearer; evaluated independently of range_inches.

reference.description: Origin of both the range and engagement_relation gates. Default bearer means the model carrying the ability; bearer-unit means its entire current unit; bearer-transport means the Transport that unit is embarked within.

selection_limit.description: Maximum selections of EACH target by this ability across ALL friendly bearers during the named period. Counter key is (controlling army, ability identity, target identity, period), not bearer identity. Selecting another target does not consume this target's counter.

model_names.description: Exact model-profile names; alternatives. Filters individual models, never the union of unit keywords.

excluded_keywords.description: A candidate with any listed keyword is excluded.

wholly.description: Each selected unit must be wholly within within_inches / range_inches.

selector.description: Legacy selectors omit min_count and retain up-to semantics. Bounded authoring requires min_count, max_count, and owner, with min_count <= max_count.

for-each-unit-effect.$comment: Resolve `effect` independently once for every matching unit, binding that unit as its target. `selector` has no count because it selects every eligible unit.

keywords.description: Keywords filtered against each candidate. Under the default `keyword_match` every listed keyword is required; under `any`, a candidate qualifies on any one of them.

keyword_match.description: Whether `keywords` is a conjunction (the default, preserving historical AND semantics) or an honest disjunction.

target_kind.description: Whether each iteration binds a whole unit or one matching model.

engagement_relation.description: Candidate engagement relation to the bearer or bearer-unit.

member_of.description: Restrict candidates to models in the ability bearer's unit, including an Attached unit. With target_kind:model every listed keyword is tested on that individual model, never the union of unit keywords.

model_names.description: Exact model-profile names; alternatives. Filters individual models, never the union of unit keywords.

excluded_keywords.description: A candidate with any listed keyword is excluded.

aura-effect.$comment: Generic aura (Batch D): a persistent zone around a unit applying an effect to units within a range. Models Contagions, Shadow in the Warp, Vect — the concept the dataset previously expressed implicitly via `target: *-within-aura` + scope.range. `range` is the radius in inches (an integer, or an array of per-battle-round tiers, e.g. [3,6,9] for Contagions). `range_bonus` + `of` model an ability that EXTENDS a named aura's range (Gift of Poxes: contagion +3"). `effect` is the nested effect applied within the zone. Batch D builds the type and migrates contagion-range; the ~300 incumbent within-aura-target effects are a separate follow-up sweep.

range_cap.description: The aura range, extensions included, never exceeds this.

designate-target-effect.$comment: Nominate one enemy or friendly unit (the designation/mark) and apply `applies.effect` keyed to it. `applies.to` decides the beneficiary: 'target' affects the marked unit itself; 'attackers-of-target' buffs every friendly attack against it; 'bearer-attacks-target' buffs only attacks made by the ability's bearer against it. Selection can constrain range and require all or any listed keywords. `select.timing` is when the mark is chosen; `duration` how long it lasts.

reference.description: Explicit built-in origin of range and visibility gates, matching select-units. bearer-transport measures from the Transport the origin unit is embarked within.

eligibility.description: Predicate on the candidate before selecting it. Event-bound history can refer to the attack sequence that caused this selection.

selection_limit.description: Maximum selections of this same target by this ability across the whole army in the named period.

attacker_keywords.description: All keywords required on each individual friendly attacking MODEL, not on its unit. Only meaningful with to:attackers-of-target.

attacker_unit_keywords.description: All keywords required on the attacking model's UNIT, including attached-unit keyword unions. Does not require those keywords on the individual model. Only meaningful with to:attackers-of-target.

stance-select-effect.$comment: Pick options from a named menu (one unless min_choices/max_choices say otherwise) of modal buffs — the dice-pool-allocation shape minus the dice. `mode`: 're-selectable' re-picks each window with no depletion (Admech Doctrina Imperatives); 'consumable' spends each option once per battle (Gladius Combat Doctrines). `scope` is who the active option applies to; `select` names when the pick is made. Each option carries a `name` and a bundle `effect` (often a sequence).

min_choices.description: Fewest options picked at once; defaults to one.

max_choices.description: Most options picked at once; defaults to one.

stance-selection-capacity-effect.$comment: Widens how many times the options of a `stance-select` menu may be selected — the capacity knob for its sibling. Gladius Task Force's Codex Discipline selects one combat doctrine one additional time per battle. `allocation`: 'choose-one-option' pools the extra selection so the player allocates it to any option of that stance; 'fixed-option' pins it to `option_id`. The stance's own menu and effects are unchanged.

risk-reward-effect.$comment: An activated buff (`reward`) that can backfire: resolve a `risk` test and, on failure, apply `risk.on_fail` to the bearer (the Hazardous-keyword pattern lifted to abilities — Chaos Dark Pacts). `risk.test` names the test taken (e.g. 'leadership').

issue-orders-effect.$comment: An officer issues up to `count` Orders per round to eligible friendly units within `range` inches, each a pick from the `options` menu (Astra Militarum Voice of Command). `count`/`eligible` are typically per-officer-datasheet; the shared menu lives on the army rule. Each option carries a `name` and the `effect` the chosen Order applies to the receiving unit.

named-region-state-effect.description: A named battlefield region: who produces it, what it does to units inside it, and when.

resource-action-menu-effect.$comment: A pool of reactive actions ('manoeuvres') that share once-per-phase caps and draw from a single resource pool (e.g. Aeldari Battle Focus). Reactivity/timing lives per-action in `when` (reusing the committed ability.schema.json trigger $def, single or array — the action fires on ANY listed trigger, exactly like an ability-level `trigger`). Pool population/expiry is NOT modelled here — it is expressed by sibling `resource-gain` / `resource-clear` effects keyed on the same `pool_id`. `menu_id` and each action's `id` are internal slugs and MUST NOT be rendered to players; `label` is the player-facing manoeuvre name.

shared_usage.$comment: Caps shared across every action, distinct from a single action's own `usage` override.

capacity.$comment: A per-refresh budget declared on the menu itself, distinct from `shared_usage` (which caps how many actions may be performed) and from each action's own `cost` (which spends the budget). Expresses rules like Librarius: a Psyker Level of 3 lets the unit use Psychic abilities whose combined level does not exceed 3 in a battle round. `ability_noun` names what the budget is spent on ('Psychic'), so the sentence reads as the card does.

resource_label.$comment: Player-facing singular noun for one unit of the budget (e.g. 'Psychic Level').

ability_noun.$comment: Player-facing noun for the budgeted abilities (e.g. 'Psychic'), rendered before 'abilities'.

when.$comment: Local variant of ability.schema.json#/$defs/trigger (see #/$defs/resource-action-menu-trigger) adding `binds_event_variable`, so a later `eligibility.requires` predicate can test a historical relation against the SAME game-object this trigger matched — not merely 'some enemy unit'.

resource_label.$comment: Optional player-facing singular noun for one unit of this pool (e.g. 'Battle Focus token'). Backward-compatible: when absent, the describer falls back to a title-cased `pool_id`.

duration.$comment: 'immediate' is a one-off action whose only lasting result is the resulting board position; the describer MUST render it with no 'until ...' clause.

resource-action-menu-trigger.$comment: A resource-action-menu action's `when` is an ordinary trigger; binds_event_variable names the object it matched for a sibling eligibility predicate.

kind.description: Union of the battlefield areas within radius_inches of each currently qualifying source unit. Re-evaluated continuously as source units move/leave/enter the battlefield; not an objective-marker selection.

attack_condition.description: Gate shared by the default and qualified branches, evaluated on each current attack, without gating production of the named region.

named-objective-state.description: A named state carried by a specific objective marker: the state resolves when its ability-level trigger fires, and may clear itself. Distinct from `objective-tag`, which only marks the objective without carrying a resolution.

clears.description: When the named state is removed from the objective.

persistent-battlefield-marker-state.description: A marker placed on the battlefield that persists after placement: matching units may set up near it, using it may consume it, and enemy proximity removes it. Distinct from `tracking-token`, which is a reminder co-located with a model rather than a placed battlefield object with its own lifecycle.

placement.description: Where the marker is placed at the moment the ability resolves.

setup_within_inches.description: Distance from the marker within which matching units may be set up.

setup_keywords.description: When present, only units carrying every listed keyword may use the marker to set up; absent means any friendly unit.

consume.description: Whether a single set-up use spends the marker.

removed_by_enemy_within_inches.description: Remove the marker once an enemy unit is within this distance of it.

keyword-filter.description: Independent keyword predicate for the aura emitter or each aura recipient. Required keywords all match; excluded keywords none match.

beneficiary-bound-effect-node.description: Targetless effect dispatched to a relation-resolved beneficiary model; bearer and unit targets are intentionally not representable.

leader-model-ability-grant-effect.description: Resolve the attached qualifying leader model and dispatch a targetless effect to that model while it leads the bearer unit.

persistent-designation-effect.$comment: Retained state is keyed by bearer unit and designation. Establishing it selects a reference and defines its consumer. A replacement-only operation updates that same designation's reference without adding another consumer or refreshing its expiry.

consumer.description: Resolve the declared bearer-model or unit beneficiary against the exact retained reference.

relation.description: Resolve this relation from the declared beneficiary to its retained unit or marker, not a generic target or nearby object.

effect.description: Nested effects apply to the declared beneficiary. An Objective Control set operation assigns the value, not a signed delta.

no-effect-effect.description: Resolve no effect; does not create attacks, damage, selections, or secondary events.

count.description: How many objectives are selected; each: resolve the effect once per matching objective.

range.description: Distance from origin to the objective (objective-control: within range of it).

roll-effect.$comment: Roll dice once and bind the result as roll_var: numeric fields inside accept {roll_var} (the total, or the count of dice at successes_on+), and dice-gated steps with `from` gate its dice. extra_dice_pool adds one die per die held in that pool, so the die count varies.

select-objective-effect.$comment: Select objective markers matching the selector and bind each as bind_as; the nested effect refers to it as {objective: {selection_var}} (designate subject, within of).
